title: ZeroScroll Remote Configuration Schema
description: Defines route guard patterns, CSS injection, single item viewer constraints, and emergency kill switch settings.

minAppVersion.description: Minimum client application semver required to apply this configuration (e.g. 1.0.0).

killSwitch.description: Emergency pause switch for the app when Meta/Instagram DOM changes break guardrails.

enabled.description: When true, WebView is not loaded and a full-screen pause notice is displayed.

message.description: Friendly user-facing explanation message displayed on the pause screen.

userAgent.description: Mobile Chrome User Agent string for WebView requests.

fallbackPath.description: Internal route path to redirect to upon encountering prohibited navigation.

allowedPaths.description: Regular expression patterns matching permitted paths (DMs, login, activity, single media).

alwaysBlockedPaths.description: Regular expression patterns matching strictly prohibited paths (feeds, explore, reels tab, profiles).

hideSelectors.description: CSS selectors targeted for permanent visual suppression (display: none !important).

extraCss.description: Sanitized supplementary CSS stylesheet. Must not contain url(), @import, expression(), or script vectors.

featureGroups.description: Modular feature groups governing path permissions and CSS selectors per feature.

viewerModeRules.description: Rules governing single media viewer mode for isolated post/reel inspection.

featureGroup.description: Rules associated with a specific feature group.
